headline: 3 off-chain corpora walked (website, docs, search); 0 AILayer-specific contract addresses confirmed on-chain; 2 cross-chain bfBTC deployments sighted via search snippets only; deployed-contracts docs page not fetchable this run.

findings.text: D1: AILayer has no canonical block explorer in the standard list (etherscan, basescan, etc.). No AILayer-specific name-tag search was possible. Search results returned Etherscan address 0xcdfb58c8c859cb3f62ebe9cf2767f9e036c7fb15 (Ethereum bfBTC) and Basescan address 0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF (Base bfBTC) via snippets only — not AILayer deployments and not directly fetched.

D2: The docs site https://docs.bitfi.one/ was confirmed live via the audit-report page fetch. The sidebar reveals a 'Deployed Contracts' page at https://docs.bitfi.one/developer/bfbtc-overview/deployed-contracts but this URL was not a prior search/fetch result and could not be fetched this run. set protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc to this URL for the next run.

D3: Docs fetch confirmed two SlowMist audit reports: bfBTC (PDF at https://docs.bitfi.one/assets/bitfi-slowmist-audit.pdf, GitHub mirror) and bfUSD (PDF at https://docs.bitfi.one/assets/bitfi-usd-slowmist-audit.pdf, GitHub mirror). No in-scope addresses were extractable from snippet data; the PDFs were not directly fetched this run.
D4: GitHub org https://github.com/bitfi-labs confirmed from docs page fetch. No repo or deployment artifacts fetched this run (no remaining fetch budget).

D5: Only chain for this slug is AILayer. No AILayer block explorer in standard list. DeFiLlama confirms $91.38M TVL on AILayer for bitfi-btc. No AILayer-specific contract addresses surfaced from any fetched source.
D6: No factory addresses discovered; not applicable this run.

D7: Role taxonomy not applicable — no AILayer addresses confirmed. The Gitbook docs describe bfBTC as an ERC-20 token with EIP-1967 Transparent Proxy pattern (evidenced on Base); expected roles: token (proxy), token (implementation), owner/admin. AILayer entries pending deployed-contracts page fetch.

D8: Ethereum address 0xcdfb58c8c859cb3f62ebe9cf2767f9e036c7fb15 and Base address 0x623F2774d9f27B59bc6b954544487532CE79d9DF appeared only in search snippets, not in directly fetched pages. Per D8 rule these go in unknowns[], not admin_addresses[].

Zero AILayer-specific contract addresses were confirmed from any fetched source. Grade is unknown pending fetch of the deployed-contracts docs page and the SlowMist audit PDFs.

protocol_metadata.about: BitFi BTC (bfBTC) is a wrapped Bitcoin token deployed on AILayer and multiple other EVM chains, functioning on AILayer as a 1:1 BTC-backed asset with no yield strategy yet activated. On other chains, users stake BTC or BTC-equivalent assets to mint bfBTC, which accrues yield via CeFi strategies managed through Ceffu's MirrorX custody engine combined with DeFi liquidity incentives. Cross-chain transfers use the LayerZero OFT standard. Users redeem by burning bfBTC to receive BTC plus accrued yield.
